page: Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DDSv5 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 48 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing 24 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage capabilities feature a bundled 1843 GB local disk, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are present in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates solid performance across standard enterprise workloads. The system achieves a Passmark CPU score of 48717.7 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 15064.0, both placing in the average tier. Notably, the server demonstrates strong performance in specific areas, including Passmark database operations (21703.24) and CPU encryption tests (43321.1), which rank in the top 25%. Memory performance is also robust, with a Passmark memory score of 2757.12 and a cached read-only small block memory bandwidth of 2502.0 GB/sec. For language model tasks, the server achieves a strong text generation speed of 275.95 tokens/second on small 135M models, though performance drops to a weak 2.74 tokens/second on large 70B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the D48ds_v5 offers a balanced resource density, pairing a high vCPU count with substantial memory and a large local NVMe storage allocation. This makes it highly suitable for database operations, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require a mix of compute, memory, and fast local temporary storage. The lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training, but its strong database and encryption benchmark results confirm its suitability for secure transactional databases, software compilation, and medium-scale web infrastructure.
description: The Microsoft Azure D48ds_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the DDSv5 family, powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor with 48 dedicated vCPUs and 24 physical cores. It features 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB per core, and includes 1843 GB of bundled local storage with Premium Storage capability. Operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this x86_64 server delivers strong performance in database operations, memory benchmarks, and CPU encryption, placing in the top 25% of tested systems. It maintains average performance in general multi-core computing, software compilation, and small-model LLM text generation. Lacking a GPU, the D48ds_v5 is highly cost-efficient for resource-dense enterprise workloads, making it an optimal fit for relational databases, secure transactional systems, and general-purpose web serving.
